parameters.content:
## Track dental lab cases and notify clinics of readiness

### How it works

A dental lab receives a new case from a clinic on a hosted form. The submission is checked, an AI agent judges whether the case is complete and writes a warm acknowledgment email back to the clinic. The case is matched to a technician, priority is scored (rush, urgent, normal) and the case is logged to the Cases sheet.

A second webhook lets the lab move a case through its stages: received, designing, milling, finishing, qc, ready, delivered or remake. Every move is logged. When a case is ready the clinic is emailed automatically, delivered cases get a confirmation email, and remakes alert the lab manager on Telegram.

Every morning at 08:00 a sweep reads the whole board, finds overdue, due-soon and stalled cases, and an AI agent writes a short production brief that lands on Discord and in the lab inbox.

### Setup steps

- Create a spreadsheet with three tabs: Cases, Status Log and Errors, using the column list in the workflow description.
- Connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Discord, Telegram and an OpenAI chat model credential.
- Set the lab manager email and Telegram chat id on the alert nodes.
- Activate the form, the status webhook and the schedule.

### Customization

- Add a clinic approval step before production.
- Switch the acknowledgment email copy in the AI system message.
- Adjust the daily brief time in the schedule trigger.

### Case intake and assessment
The intake form is normalized and validated, gpt-6-luna assesses completeness and drafts the clinic acknowledgment, then the case is planned, logged to the Cases tab and announced on Gmail and Discord.

nodes.name: Section Status Updates And Clinic Alerts

parameters.content:
### Status updates and clinic alerts
A second webhook receives lab stage changes, validates the case and stage, updates the Cases row and appends to the Status Log. Ready and delivered cases email the clinic, and remakes page the lab manager.

### Daily production brief
Every morning at 08:00 the board is read, overdue, due-soon and stalled cases are computed, gpt-6-luna writes the brief, and it lands on Discord, in the lab inbox and on Telegram when something is overdue.
